name: sla-breach
description: Was the first-response SLA breached? Business hours, holidays, the opening priority, and only agent replies count. Tickets with no reply yet are judged at `now`.

input.policy_text:
Support SLA (2026).
First-response targets by priority:
- Urgent: within 1 hour, around the clock (all days, all hours).
- High: within 4 business hours.
- Normal and Low: within 2 business days (16 business hours).
Business hours are 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, excluding these public holidays: 2026-01-01, 2026-04-03, 2026-05-25, 2026-12-25.
The priority a ticket had when it was opened is the one that applies, even if it is changed later.
Only a reply from a support agent counts as a first response; customer messages and automatic acknowledgements do not.
